analysis.title: Memory: Pricing in disaster? The Memory Massacre, Has The Market Gone Too Far
key_insights: Memory stocks led selling across North Asia last week, contributing to an eighth consecutive week of tech selling, per GS trading desk data. Asia fundamental L/S net leverage has fallen to record lows.
Technicals are deeply oversold. Samsung, Hynix and Kioxia were hit in the AI hardware unwind, and SK Hynix weekly RSI is at its lowest level in years.
GS says current Samsung and Hynix valuations price in zero AI capex growth in 2028 plus an additional 40% decline in memory ASPs, well below the bank's base case.
GS (Giuni Lee) still expects a memory shortage in 2027. DRAM undersupply narrows from 5.1% in 2027 to 1.2% in 2028, and NAND undersupply from 2.2% to 0.3%.
GS forecasts DRAM prices +32% in 2027 then -19% in 2028, and NAND +20% then -21%.
GS raised HBM TAM forecasts to $60bn in 2026, $200bn in 2027 and $237bn in 2028, mainly on higher ASP assumptions. That is more than 3x growth next year.

In a stress test with DRAM and NAND ASPs both down 50% YoY in 2028, Samsung operating profit falls 54% below base case. It would still have a 35% operating margin and trade at 4.7x earnings and 1.0x book on downside estimates.

GS says conventional DRAM prices would need to fall 32-54% below its forecasts over two years before customers have an economic incentive to default on LTAs. This offers some protection but not against weaker demand or renegotiation.

GS forecasts Samsung shareholder returns of ₩187tn in 2027 and ₩195tn in 2028, and Hynix returns of ₩135tn and ₩138tn. Kioxia trades near 1.5x FY2028 earnings with a potential shareholder return yield above 30%.
In the 2017-2019 downturn Hynix shares troughed well ahead of earnings, so the equity bottom may come well before the earnings bottom.

market_movers.rationale: Samsung valuation implies a severe 2028 downturn. Stress case at 4.7x earnings and 1.0x book with a 35% operating margin, and large forecast shareholder returns.
SK Hynix weekly RSI is at multi-year lows and GS forecasts ₩135tn and ₩138tn of shareholder returns in 2027 and 2028.
Kioxia trades near 1.5x FY2028 earnings with a potential shareholder return yield above 30% per GS.

sector_views.rationale: 2027 stays tight but 2028 pricing falls. The market already discounts more than GS's base case, so downside looks partly priced.

earnings_insights: GS forecast: Samsung shareholder returns ₩187tn in 2027 and ₩195tn in 2028. Hynix ₩135tn and ₩138tn.
GS stress case (forecast, DRAM and NAND ASPs -50% YoY in 2028): Samsung operating profit 54% below base case, 35% operating margin, 4.7x earnings.
risk_factors: 2028 memory ASP decline could exceed GS forecasts, with a 50% collapse stress case.
Weaker AI demand or LTA renegotiations could override contract protection.
AI capex growth could stall in 2028.
Equity bottom timing may differ from earnings bottom, so further downside is possible.

tension_points.bull_case: Valuations already price zero AI capex growth in 2028 and a further 40% ASP decline. Even a 50% ASP collapse leaves Samsung at a 35% margin and 4.7x earnings, with large shareholder returns and LTA protection.
tension_points.bear_case: GS 2028 undersupply narrows sharply and prices fall 19% for DRAM and 21% for NAND. Demand weakness or LTA renegotiation could worsen the downturn, and positioning and tech selling are still running.
tension_points.what_invalidates: DRAM prices falling more than 32-54% below GS forecasts, which would give customers an incentive to default on LTAs.
